question: Apply spectral clustering to the dataset. Use the RBF kernel with gamma=0.01 to construct the similarity matrix. Report the eigenvalues of the Laplacian matrix used in the clustering and determine the optimal number of clusters.

expected_output.guidelines: Ascending eigenvalue records must match the reference within +/-0.01; column naming may differ.
Plot must show sorted Laplacian eigenvalues as a line with the eigengap annotated; axis labels and styling may differ.
